paper_title: Tri-Diketopyrrolopyrrole Molecular Donor Materials for High-Performance Solution-Processed Bulk Heterojunction Solar Cells
source_file: /home/wzfeng/MySearch/PhotoRag/MD/Advanced Materials - 2013 - Liu - Tri‐Diketopyrrolopyrrole Molecular Donor Materials for High‐Performance/auto/Advanced Materials - 2013 - Liu - Tri‐Diketopyrrolopyrrole Molecular Donor Materials for High‐Performance.md

knowledge_points.content: The tri-DPP molecular architecture utilizes a DPP-phenyl group as the central moiety instead of the electron-donating conjugated moieties typically found in bis-DPP structures.
knowledge_points.evidence: A key feature of this molecular architecture is the use of a DPP-phenyl group as the central moiety instead of the various electron donating conjugated moieties commonly used in bis-DPPs.

knowledge_points.content: The tri-DPP molecule 5b, featuring linear n-hexyl side chains, achieved a peak power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 5.5% with a short-circuit current density (Jsc) of 10.40 mA/cm², a Voc of 0.86 V, and a fill factor (FF) of 61.7% when processed with 1-chloronaphthalene (CN).
knowledge_points.evidence: Devices fabricated from 5b:PC71BM with the highest performance was obtained with a slightly higher PC71BM content (40:60) using 1% CN as the solvent additive, generating a Jsc of 10.40 mA cm-2, Voc of 0.86 V, FF of 61%, and PCE of 5.5%.

knowledge_points.content: Incorporating an additional electron-deficient DPP unit into the central position of the molecular backbone results in low-lying HOMO energy levels of -5.4 eV (for 5a) and -5.2 eV (for 5b), which are deeper than most reported DPP-containing materials.
knowledge_points.evidence: The incorporation of an extra electron-deficient DPP unit imparts this series of tri-DPPs with low-lying highest occupied molecular orbital (HOMO) energy levels... The determined HOMO levels are -5.4 and -5.2 eV for 5a and 5b, respectively, which are deeper than that of most reported DPP-containing molecules and polymers.

knowledge_points.content: The choice of side chains significantly affects thermal properties; replacing linear n-hexyl chains (5b) with branched 2-ethylhexyl chains (5a) on the central DPP unit decreases the melting temperature (Tm) from 254 °C to 228 °C and the crystallization temperature (Tc) from 234 °C to 196 °C.
knowledge_points.evidence: Both the Tm and Tc decrease significantly from 254 °C to 228 °C and from 234 °C to 196 °C, respectively, when replacing linear alkyl chains with the branched ones.

knowledge_points.content: Tri-DPP molecules 5a and 5b exhibit ambipolar charge transport with hole-dominant behavior; 5b shows higher saturation hole mobility (3.9 x 10⁻³ cm²/V·s) compared to 5a (4.5 x 10⁻⁴ cm²/V·s) in FET devices at room temperature.
knowledge_points.evidence: Both 5a and 5b exhibit ambipolar transport characteristics... indicating dominant p-type behavior... For 5b, μh and μe are higher than those of 5a (μh = 3.9 × 10-3 cm2 V-1 s-1 and μe = 8.0 × 10-4 cm2 V-1 s-1).

knowledge_points.content: Thin-film X-ray diffraction (XRD) demonstrates that the linear-chain molecule 5b has a higher tendency for crystallization than the branched-chain molecule 5a, showing distinct diffraction peaks with a d-spacing of 1.53 nm.
knowledge_points.evidence: As shown in Figure 1b, 5b exhibits distinct diffraction peaks (d spacing: 1.53 nm) in the small angle region for both as-cast and annealed films while compound 5a only shows a weak diffraction peak at a similar 2θ value after thermal annealing.

knowledge_points.content: The response of tri-DPP molecules to solvent additives is highly dependent on side-chain structure; 5a:PC71BM blends require 1,8-diiodooctane (DIO) to optimize performance, whereas 5b:PC71BM blends perform optimally with 1-chloronaphthalene (CN).
knowledge_points.evidence: The optimal device of 5a was produced... with 1% DIO as a solvent additive... highest performance [for 5b] was obtained... using 1% CN as the solvent additive... solvent additives play completely different roles on both molecules even with a very subtle structural variation on alkyl substitutions.

knowledge_points.content: Tri-DPP molecules exhibit fill factors (FF) exceeding 60%, which is significantly higher than typical mono-DPP molecules (FF < 50%) and comparable to polymer-based bulk heterojunction solar cells.
knowledge_points.evidence: Typically, mono-DPP compounds were found to have FFs less than 50%... In this work, tri-DPP compounds are found to have FFs exceeding 60% which is comparable to FFs in polymer BHJ devices.

knowledge_points.content: The solubility of tri-DPP molecules in chloroform is drastically affected by side-chain branching, with 5a (branched) reaching over 25 mg/mL, while 5b (linear) is limited to 10 mg/mL.
knowledge_points.evidence: The solubility of 5a in chloroform is over 25 mg mL-1; however, replacing the branched alkyl chains with the linear alkyl chains reduces the solubility substantially to 10 mg mL-1 for 5b.

knowledge_points.content: The optical bandgaps (Eg,opt) for 5a and 5b are nearly identical at 1.65 eV and 1.64 eV, respectively, calculated from the absorption onset of annealed films.
knowledge_points.evidence: Table 1. Summary of Intrinsic Physical Properties... Egopt (d): 5a = 1.65, 5b = 1.64.

knowledge_points.content: The optimized donor-to-acceptor (D:A) blend ratio for 5b:PC71BM solar cells is 40:60, which reflects a higher acceptor content characteristic of polymer-based organic solar cells rather than typical small-molecule systems.
knowledge_points.evidence: Additionally, we notice that the tri-DPP devices are optimized with higher acceptor content similar to what have been observed for most polymer BHJ solar cells whereas some of high performance solution-processed small molecule BHJ devices are usually optimized at higher donor contents.

knowledge_points.content: Thermal annealing at 100 °C optimizes charge transport in tri-DPP films, yielding maximum hole mobilities of 6.1 x 10⁻⁴ cm²/V·s for 5a and 4.3 x 10⁻³ cm²/V·s for 5b in FET configurations.
knowledge_points.evidence: Highest carrier transport mobilities (5a: μh ~ = 6.1 × 10-4 cm2 V-1 s-1... 5b: μh = 4.3 × 10-3 cm2 V-1 s-1...) were observed after thermal annealing of as-cast films at 100 °C.
